title: claudex wait event, version 1
description: The result of a bounded wait: the wake reason and the observed run status. Every discriminant a client needs to act is present; unchanged carries the newest observed revision so the client can advance its cursor.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn to act on, present only for an assignment; null otherwise.

gate_id.description: The open gate, present for a gate that has an issued gate id; null otherwise.

replacement_generation.description: The generation of the session that superseded this one, present only for session_replaced; null otherwise.

required_generation.description: The fresh pair-session generation that must attach before a verifier turn issues, present only for fresh_session_required; null otherwise.

code.description: The stop's projection code, present for a failure or a required recovery; null otherwise.

reason.description: The stop's redacted reason, present for a failure or a required recovery; null otherwise.

next_action.description: The exact next action, present for a failure or a required recovery; null otherwise.
